purpose: Independent simulated beginner mouse-only observation of composing, mixing, saving and exporting a 30-second piece in RILL.
persona: Simulated first-time RILL beginner interested in a short melodic instrumental.

rating_reasons.easy_to_use: The MIDI hint, note Pencil, numerical property keypad, Mixer labels and export menus let me finish using the mouse. Repeating a one-bar melody needed many clicks and playback recovery interrupted the flow.
rating_reasons.how_cool_it_looks: The dark interface, teal waveforms, clear piano notes and visible routing lines look coherent and attractive. The Mixer has a lot of unused space with only three channels.
rating_reasons.how_fast_it_is: Drawing, duplication, numeric edits and mix controls visibly responded quickly. WAV rendering took roughly tens of seconds and playback needed retries; elapsed session time includes tool and screenshot overhead.
rating_reasons.how_confusing_it_is: Duplicate is a tool that requires clicking a clip after selecting it. Mixer controls moved vertically when a status banner appeared or disappeared, making follow-up clicks uncertain. I also misread a key on the on-screen keyboard and corrected the name.
rating_reasons.feature_completeness: I found all requested task features: audio, MIDI notes, the installed VST3, volume/pan/mute/solo, bus/send, project save, WAV and MIDI export. Playback was unreliable in this laboratory session, and broader plugins or advanced production features were not tested.

findings.observation: Double-clicking the visible MIDI drop area opened Device library. Assign instrument created a MIDI track labeled Rill Lab Sine. Pencil drags created C4, E4, G4, E4 notes.
Clicking Duplicate changed the current tool and displayed Click a clip to duplicate. Building the repeated melody required clicking successive clips and zooming out as the arrangement grew.
The Properties 123 control opened a clickable numeric keypad. Changing the last audio clip duration from 16 to 8 beats in Trim mode visibly set its end and the project duration to 0:30.000.

Mixer fader drags changed audio from -6.0 to -8.4 dB and MIDI from -2.5 to -4.4 dB. Horizontal knob drags changed pan to L20 and R20. Mute and Solo visibly highlighted when tried and were later cleared.
Add bus created a New bus strip. The audio track Add send opened Routing; + Send then New bus created a 0.25x Post send. Mixer showed Send · New bus, Bus 1 in, routing lines and later a bus meter.
Playback advanced but stopped with Audio output stream failed or disconnected on two visible occasions. Error details reported ALSA snd_pcm_avail_delay I/O error (5), 48000 Hz and 1024 frames.
The status banner changed the available Mixer height, moving mute/solo/pan positions between screenshots. Consecutive clicks at old positions did not reliably target the same control.
Retry playback cleared the banner and resumed transport. A later screenshot showed position 007.04.58 and nonzero audio, MIDI, bus and master meters. I stopped playback manually afterwards.
Rename project offered a mouse keyboard. I initially entered apostrophes where I intended letter l, used Clear, re-entered little orbit and applied it. Save dialog reused the chosen name.

Saving returned to the named project without the unsaved dot. WAV export displayed Arrangement · 0:30 after effect tails were unchecked. Both exports displayed Exported notices for the chosen filenames. The error details later showed the absolute project file path.

outcome.status: Completed in the UI: 30-second arrangement, named project saved, WAV and MIDI success notices seen, and all requested Mixer actions performed. Playback errors occurred and recovered; file contents remain independently unverified.
outcome.composition: 112 BPM, 4/4. Startup Circuit rhythm audio duplicated through 14 bars, with final audio copy trimmed to two bars. A one-bar C4-E4-G4-E4 melody drawn with the mouse was duplicated to 14 one-bar MIDI clips. New bus receives a post-fader audio send. The result is a simple repeated melodic instrumental.
outcome.playback_observed: Play/Pause changed, transport and playhead advanced. Two visible stream-failure notices interrupted playback; error details named ALSA I/O error (5). Retry later resumed playback to 007.04.58 with audio, MIDI, bus and master meters active. Playback was stopped manually; uninterrupted full-piece playback was not established.

limitations: All composition and app operations used only the assigned visible session and mouse driver. Report writing was the only direct file-writing operation.
No file contents or heard audio claim; independent coordinator verification follows. Artifact paths come from the native save dialogs and visible project error details.
The timer-paced virtual audio sink and software graphics are laboratory conditions. Stream failures and responsiveness here do not establish physical-device behavior or audio quality.
Only the installed Rill Lab Sine VST3 was used. No claims about other plugins.
Track balance was adjusted visually and numerically, without audition. The music is a short repeating motif, not a judged audio mix.

Some screenshot filenames describe the intended next observation: 34-wav-export-success.png still shows Exporting; actual WAV success is in 35-wav-export-status.png. 19-playback-failure-details.png shows recovered meters; actual details are in 42-playback-error-detail.png.

mixer_outcome.volume: Dragged audio fader to -8.4 dB and MIDI fader to -4.4 dB, with numeric feedback. Bus remained 0.0 dB. No auditory balance judgment.
mixer_outcome.pan: Dragged audio pan left to L20 and MIDI pan right to R20; both labels and knobs changed.
mixer_outcome.mute: Clicked audio Mute; it visibly highlighted amber. Clicked again to clear. Final Mixer and arrangement show it off.
mixer_outcome.solo: Clicked MIDI Solo; it visibly highlighted, and a later screenshot showed MIDI/master meter activity with audio meter empty. Cleared Solo before save and export.
mixer_outcome.bus: Clicked top Add bus; New bus appeared as a distinct BUS strip and later showed Bus 1 in.
mixer_outcome.send: Clicked audio Add send, then + Send, then New bus. Routing displayed 0.25x with Post selected. Mixer displayed Send · New bus and a Post send routing line; the bus meter later became active.
